summary: Knight-Swift Transportation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a private offering of $1.5 billion (including an upsized option of $200 million) of 1.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. The notes are general senior unsecured obligations maturing November 15, 2031, with semi-annual interest payments starting November 15, 2026. Conversion is contingent on stock-price thresholds or specific trading-price conditions. The filing is a routine capital-raising event—a convertible note issuance—not a special situation triggering activist, strategic, or structural change. There is no deal with a target, buyer, or activist. What to watch: conversion triggers and impact on share dilution.
